caption:
Toto has been streaming on the couch for hours with his tablet flat on his lap, and now his neck feels stiff every time he looks up.

It's often less about one 'bad posture' and more about holding the same head-down position for a long time. Propping the screen higher and changing position often may help your neck feel more comfortable.

Hybi's tip: rest the tablet on a cushion or stand, switch positions every 20–30 minutes, and add a few gentle chin tucks and shoulder rolls.

Arm tingling, dizziness or headaches are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
